sql:
WITH activity_rows AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    a.activity_id,
    a.molecule_chembl_id,
    a.assay_id,
    a.standard_type,
    a.standard_relation,
    a.pchembl_value,
    ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
    ass.assay_type,
    td.tid AS target_tid,
    td.target_type,
    td.tax_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
    md.pref_name
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.molregno
  LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
  WHERE
    a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
    AND td.tid = 2150837
    AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
    AND md.molecule_type = 'Small molecule'
    AND md.pref_name IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  assay_chembl_id,
  target_type,
  tax_id,
  canonical_smiles,
  molecule_chembl_id,
  standard_type,
  pchembl_value
FROM activity_rows
ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id ASC, assay_chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000
